Record-Breaking Pumpkins Grown in Consecutive Weeks

Two separate record-breaking pumpkins were grown in consecutive weeks, with the most recent one surpassing the previous record. One pumpkin was grown by a farmer in Rhode Island, and another, described as the size of a car, also set a new record.
